changes.summary: Allow notification rules to target groups and effective roles with tenant isolation and delivery-time membership resolution.
Adapt notification persistence, routing and settings validation to the canonical error API.
Complete notification routing, semantic recipients, severity, keyset history, realtime Redis fanout and durable batched delivery with retry controls.
Isolate best-effort user-created notification failures with a savepoint and correct notification UI wording and template formatting.
Add persistent tenant-scoped in-app notifications with an event catalog, configurable recipients, test delivery, a polling notification center, and a built-in user-created event.
Update the SDK navigation parity fixture for notification settings added by #1157. Test fixture only; no runtime or API changes.
